Buffer Stage

Buffer Explanation

Updated this week
The Buffer Stage simplifies the journey to a funded account, helping you build a financial buffer with less stress.

The simulated profit target accrued in your Buffer account will be matched in your Sim Funded Account. There is a max amount set per account type. Stop trading when you reach the target goal.

 

(Only the target or profit goal (described below) of the buffer account is transferrable to Sim Funded any other Profits are forfeited.)

This is not an evaluation step; it's the stage you build your funded buffer. This is a way to help traders transition forward with less stress, delay increased data costs, and help reduce our company's risk at the same time.

 

We keep the consistency rule in place to help you train your mindset and succeed in brokerage.

Only Remaining Rules:

Premium accounts:


The trailing drawdown that becomes static once you reach the balance indicated in the table below. 
​
​Static Growth account:


Keep the balance over $149,000
​
​Static Growth+ account:


Keep the balance over $198,000

 

34% consistency applies in the BluLive/Buffer Zone — 21% on 300K accounts. This covers all Launch, Premium and Static plans.

 

So this means:

You start building your buffer funds that will be transferred to your Sim Funded account.

Stay Patient - You will get there with the right mindset

Let's explore how this compares to the previous approach:

The new structure offers several advantages that can reduce your stress and enhance your chances of success:

There is no setup fee after the evaluation. You won't have to worry about putting more money on the line. (Exception in Launch Plans)

There is no daily loss limit. You can trade with complete confidence, unrestricted.

Simulated executions: You can adapt more gradually while still making money for your brokerage account, even though it's not a real live brokerage account yet.

Quicker account creation: We no longer need to coordinate with the brokerage right after the evaluation, enabling faster setup.

Reduced initial risk for our company so we can reduce rules and increase trader resources in the long term.

Once you've reached the targeted balance in BluLive:

We will transition you to a Sim Funded Account. This account will have a static drawdown and allow for withdrawals, as indicated by the specified amount below. Do not continue to trade over the target balance below. Please ensure to have all positions closed when you have reached your specified profit target as indicated by your dashboard; Excess earnings will not be transferred to your Sim Funded account. We can periodically review your account for contract increases - If we grant any contract increases, we will also raise the static drawdown limit to adjust with the contract increase. This is being done because the risk of increasing contracts can cause a quicker adverse action, resulting in losing the account.
